news.title: SpaceX正式启动IPO进程
news.snippet: SpaceX已正式启动IPO进程。上周，Elon Musk旗下公司秘密向美国监管机构提交上市申请。
news.raw_snippet: Last week, Elon Musk's SpaceX confidentially filed for a U.S. IPO, with the company reportedly seeking a $1.75 trillion valuation. According to reports from Bloomberg News and Reuters on April 1, billionaire Elon Musk's SpaceX has confidentially filed for a U.S. IPO. Although space and AI represent two of the most lucrative addressable markets right now, there are five specific reasons I plan to completely avoid the SpaceX IPO. One of the primary reasons I have no interest in owning shares of SpaceX when it IPOs is the company's valuation. SpaceX appears to mirror the same price dislocations observed in Musk's other public company, electric vehicle (EV) maker Tesla. To somewhat build on the previous point, the SpaceX IPO all but ensures that Musk's attention will be spread thin between two potential trillion-dollar companies. The fourth reason I'm less than enthused about the forthcoming SpaceX IPO is the capital-intensive nature of the company's projects.
